from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cnt=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    def runs(line,col):
        out=[]; i=0
        while i<len(line):
            if line[i]!=col: i+=1; continue
            j=i
            while j+1<len(line) and line[j+1]==col: j+=1
            out.append((i,j)); i=j+1
        return out
    objs=[]
    for col,n in cnt.items():
        if col==bg: continue
        top=runs(grid[0],col); bot=runs(grid[-1],col)
        left=runs([row[0] for row in grid],col); right=runs([row[-1] for row in grid],col)
        if top and bot:
            for a in top:
                for b in bot:
                    if a[1]-a[0]==b[1]-b[0]:
                        objs.append(('h',col,a,b))
        if left and right:
            for a in left:
                for b in right:
                    if a[1]-a[0]==b[1]-b[0]:
                        objs.append(('v',col,a,b))
    if not objs: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # favor source positions aligned with exactly one of the paired apertures
    other_counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=bg)
    # only candidates where other non-wall contents exist
    def candidate_score(x):
        ori,wall,a,b=x
        ss=[(r,c) for r in range(1,h-1) for c in range(1,w-1) if grid[r][c]!=bg and grid[r][c]!=wall]
        idxs=[c for r,c in ss] if ori=='h' else [r for r,c in ss]
        ia=sum(a[0]<=i<=a[1] for i in idxs); ib=sum(b[0]<=i<=b[1] for i in idxs)
        return max(ia,ib), ia+ib, (a[1]-a[0]+1)+(b[1]-b[0]+1)
    ori,wall,a,b=max(objs,key=candidate_score)
    ss=[(r,c) for r in range(1,h-1) for c in range(1,w-1) if grid[r][c]!=bg and grid[r][c]!=wall]
    seed_color=Counter(grid[r][c] for r,c in ss).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    scores=[]
    for r,c in ss:
        ix=c if ori=='h' else r
        ia=a[0]<=ix<=a[1]; ib=b[0]<=ix<=b[1]
        scores.append((ia,ib))
    ia_count=sum(x[0] for x in scores); ib_count=sum(x[1] for x in scores)
    # first interval means top/left, second bottom/right
    first_side=ia_count>=ib_count
    for r,c in ss:
        idx=c if ori=='h' else r
        first=a[0]<=idx<=a[1]; second=b[0]<=idx<=b[1]
        toward_first = first_side if first else (not first_side if second else True)
        # choose relevant matching run, same aperture-relative position
        if first and (first_side or not second):
            own,opp=a,b
        elif second and (not first_side or not first):
            own,opp=b,a
        else:
            own,opp=(a,b) if first_side else (b,a)
            toward_first=first_side
        if ori=='h':
            if toward_first:
                step=-1
                for rr in range(r-1,0,-1):
                    if out[rr][c]==bg: out[rr][c]=seed_color
                mapped=opp[0]+(c-own[0])
                for rr in range(h-2,-1,-1):
                    if out[rr][mapped]==bg: out[rr][mapped]=seed_color
            else:
                for rr in range(r+1,h-1):
                    if out[rr][c]==bg: out[rr][c]=seed_color
                mapped=opp[0]+(c-own[0])
                for rr in range(1,h):
                    if out[rr][mapped]==bg: out[rr][mapped]=seed_color
        else:
            if toward_first: # left side
                for cc in range(c-1,0,-1):
                    if out[r][cc]==bg: out[r][cc]=seed_color
                mapped=opp[0]+(r-own[0])
                for cc in range(w-2,-1,-1):
                    if out[mapped][cc]==bg: out[mapped][cc]=seed_color
            else: # right side
                for cc in range(c+1,w-1):
                    if out[r][cc]==bg: out[r][cc]=seed_color
                mapped=opp[0]+(r-own[0])
                for cc in range(1,w):
                    if out[mapped][cc]==bg: out[mapped][cc]=seed_color
        out[r][c]=4
    return out
